explicit_unsupported_or_out_of_scope_con: gzFile-family file APIs are outside this scenario-bounded z_stream protocol specification.
inflateBack-family APIs are outside this scenario-bounded z_stream protocol specification.

deflateCopy, deflateParams, deflateResetKeep, deflateSetHeader, inflateSetDictionary, inflateReset2, inflatePrime, inflateSync, and inflateGetHeader are explicitly outside this version's modeled API set unless a later reviewed specification revision brings them into scope.

gzip wrapper mode itself is not excluded: core modeled z_stream initialization, use, reset, copy, ownership, and End obligations apply to supported zlib, raw, and gzip wrapper modes. Wrapper-specific metadata/header obligations are not added.
Absence of a transition from the partial transition relation does not by itself mean protocol validity or violation.
No general post-Z_STREAM_END inflate prohibition is asserted; T17 models repeated inflate in DONE as returning Z_STREAM_END while remaining in INFLATE_STREAM_END.

The deflateSetDictionary raw-deflate block-boundary exception is limited to the conditions documented by the pinned public header and implementation; post-error dictionary use is not described as documented-valid.

General compression correctness, arbitrary C semantic errors, buffer overflows, and memory-safety defects are outside the protocol specification unless entailed by an explicit modeled protocol obligation.

deflate_state_abstraction.DEFLATE_ACTIVE: Documented call-history abstraction: at least one deflate call has occurred and Z_STREAM_END has not been returned in the current lifecycle.
deflate_state_abstraction.DEFLATE_READY: Documented call-history abstraction: successful deflate initialization or reset with no subsequent deflate call in the current lifecycle.

format_scope.build_availability_claim: No independent protocol claim is made that every build configuration enables gzip. Core lifecycle obligations apply when the corresponding supported wrapper mode is selected.

inflateCopy_source_destination_split.destination: T15 is the successful destination ACQUIRE transition.
inflateCopy_source_destination_split.source: Source validity is a precondition with ownership effect NONE; T15 is not a source-side transition.

resource_instance_lifecycle.INIT_FAILED: Terminal for the current failed acquisition attempt.
resource_instance_lifecycle.RELEASED: Terminal for the current successfully acquired resource instance.
resource_instance_lifecycle.fsm_identity: One logical FSM instance models one acquisition attempt or one successfully acquired internal-state lifecycle.
resource_instance_lifecycle.later_initialization: A later initialization or copy after INIT_FAILED or RELEASED begins a fresh logical FSM instance rather than an outgoing transition of the old instance.

transition_relation_semantics.absent_transition: Absence alone does not establish validity or violation. A protocol violation requires an explicit frozen obligation. An in-scope interaction with insufficient modeled semantics must not be silently treated as valid.
